verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom templates, which capture a machine and its configuration so you can create new machines with your exact specifications, and lets you pick a custom template at machine creation. Separately, Deployments are containers-as-a-service that run container images. Root SSH access lets you shape the environment before templating it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing your own Docker image (registry or private image support) for Deployments or Notebooks, in-depth template workflow docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: Custom templates are templates of your machines and their configurations. You can use these custom templates to create new machines with your specifications.
When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template
Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
